name: God Protection
overview: Scripture reveals that God is our steadfast protector who provides refuge and deliverance amid trouble, as seen in Psalms where He is described as a hiding place and a shield against adversity. Believers who dwell in His presence are assured of His sustaining power and peace, even when facing enemies or trials, with promises that no weapon formed against them will succeed. Christ’s victory over the world assures us that though tribulation is inevitable, we can be encouraged and upheld by God's righteous hand and abiding strength.
